ggbothy_walker.text: Welcome to the bothy. The rules are simple: leave it tidier than you found it, and leave some dry wood.
The Mountain Bothies Association has looked after huts like this since 1965. They are free for anybody to use.
The Great Glen is a long straight valley where the land cracked along a fault. You can walk or paddle coast to coast.

then.text: That was my spare flask. The kettle is on if you want another, but I have only the one mug.

else.text: Kelpies live in the lochs. If the water looks too calm, do not swim. Have a flask of tea instead.
